tools.name: getImageDownloadUrl
tools.description: Returns the unsigned CDN URL of the image with format and dimensions. Pass `max_dimension` to receive a CDN rendition downscaled to fit that many pixels on the longest side (works for every format). Pass `format` (jpg, png, webp) to convert the file. `max_dimension` and `format` compose. Renditions are generated on the fly by the CDN's image-resizing service (the first generation may require a browser-like client). Requires the `images` feature.

format.description: Convert to this format (jpg, png, webp)

max_dimension.description: Fit the longest side to this many pixels (16-16384, downscale only)

tools.name: getVideoDownloadUrl

tools.name: getVideoDownloadUrls
tools.description: Resolves CDN download URLs for up to 50 videos in a single request — use this instead of calling getVideoDownloadUrl per video. Results are returned in the order the ids were given, each carrying its `id`. A video with no available source is returned with a null `download_url` rather than failing the batch. Requires the `content_download` feature on the business's subscription. Not paginated: the response is bounded by the ids you send.

video_ids.description: Video IDs to resolve, 1 to 50 per request

tools.name: listAiCurationFeed
tools.description: Lists social videos the AI curation engine discovered for the channel, scored and summarized. An empty feed usually means the curation settings are not configured (updateAiCurationSettings) or no social account is connected (createAiCurationConnectUrl). Each item's `id` is the opaque handle to pass to importAiCuration; filter with `consent_status=approved` or `whitelist_only=true` to browse content that is cleared for importing. Forward-only pagination. Requires the `ai_content_curation` feature.

after.description: Opaque cursor for the next page (from `pagination.cursor` or `links.next`).

external_ids.description: Comma-separated platform ids to re-fetch specific feed items; requires `source`.

hashtags.description: Comma-separated discovery hashtags to filter by.

inserted_at_begin.description: Only feed items discovered at or after this time (ISO 8601 timestamp).

inserted_at_end.description: Only feed items discovered at or before this time (ISO 8601 timestamp).

whitelist_only.description: Only posts by creators on the whitelist.

tools.name: listLiveStreamAttributedOrders
tools.description: Returns fixed last touch orders where `conversion_days < 7`, ordered ascending by source interaction date, livestream status, and host order ID, with a unique internal tie breaker. The report date is the source interaction date for both active and replay orders, so an active order can differ from its broadcast date. Results include only completed UTC days and recent dates can change as later purchases arrive within the attribution window. Pagination does not provide a snapshot across data refreshes; restart from the first page after a refresh.

after.description: Opaque cursor for the next page

page_size.description: Page size (default 50, values above 100 are clamped)

tools.name: listLiveStreamChatMessages
tools.description: Accepts OAuth app tokens or OAuth user tokens. User access follows business membership and allowed channels; CMS session tokens are rejected. Returns public chats, private chats, moderator messages, and AI replies from Insights, including test livestreams and messages with null text or IDs. Moderator sender IDs are SecretId encoded; invalid or out of range moderator identifiers and AI sender IDs are null. Viewer pixel IDs remain unchanged. Ordered ascending by UTC server receipt time, with an internal tie breaker. Source message IDs are not unique. Preserves idle and paused statuses. There are no date filters or API date cutoff; availability depends on completed forwarding and historical loading. Pagination is not a snapshot across refreshes. A cursor whose anchor was replaced returns 400; restart from the first page after a refresh. To compare with total_chats, count viewer public and private messages, excluding AI and moderators, with matching source dates, statuses, and refresh timing.

after.description: Opaque continuation cursor; invalidated if its source anchor is replaced

live_stream_status.description: Exact source status; omit for all

tools.name: listLiveStreamMessages
tools.description: Cursor-paginated approved public viewer comments for active livestreams and replays. Active livestreams support forward polling with `after`/`since`, defaulting to the last 30 seconds. At the live edge, `pagination.has_more` is false but `links.next` remains available; wait between polls. Backward paging is only available for replays. Replays support `after`/`before` cursors or seeking by `since`/`until` (elapsed-time/value window), with `links.next` becoming null when paging reaches the end.

before.description: Opaque cursor for the previous page; descending order.

tools.name: showLiveStreamMinutelyStats
tools.description: Returns shared livestream metadata and the complete sparse `minutes` series in ascending elapsed minute order. Only source minutes 1 through 1500 are returned; missing minutes are omitted. There is no pagination. Includes test livestreams and source minutes after the recorded event end. Reads offline V3 broadcast metrics for broadcasts whose UTC start date is through yesterday, including active and paused activity; replay is excluded. The cutoff uses broadcast start date, not completion time. The source refresh is scheduled hourly; processing delays and later refreshes can change results. Unknown numeric source values remain null. Viewer counts use distinct visitors observed within a minute, with the source taking the maximum across event date and status groups; the series maximum can exceed the main API's peak concurrent viewer count. Minutely engagement sums can also differ from the main report. Highlighted product clicks are included in product clicks and must not be added to them. Requires owning business access and the live_events feature. livestreams:write and api:admin also satisfy the livestreams:read scope requirement. Shared business or feature access failures return 401. Missing authentication can return an empty 401 response. A valid livestream without eligible data returns 200 with an empty minutes array. Both minute bounds must be integers from 1 through 1500 with from_minute less than or equal to to_minute; invalid bounds return 400. Minute filters do not filter metadata.

to_minute.description: Inclusive last elapsed minute; omitted returns all available minutes within the cap
